purpose: Defines the pending authorization request fields (PA-RQ- prefix) copied under 01 PENDING-AUTH-REQUEST in COPAUA0C. The MQ request is a comma-delimited text string that COPAUA0C UNSTRINGs into these 18 fields in order; the amount arrives as text and is converted with NUMVAL into PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-AMT. The fields are later copied into the PAUTDTL1 detail segment.

key_fields.name: PA-RQ-AUTH-TIME
key_fields.meaning: Request time; also echoed as the response auth id code.

key_fields.name: PA-RQ-CARD-NUM
key_fields.meaning: Card number used to read the card cross-reference.

key_fields.name: PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-AMT
key_fields.meaning: Requested amount, numeric-edited +9(10).99, compared with available credit.

key_fields.name: PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-ID
key_fields.meaning: Transaction id echoed in the response.

observations.text: PA-RQ-TRANSACTION-AMT is a numeric-edited field (+9(10).99) that receives a COMPUTE result and is then moved to numeric fields; correct but unusual.
